items.title: 19.2 Hydrocarbons (sirf carbon aur hydrogen ke compounds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 19.2, PDF pages 39-40.

blocks.title: Hydrocarbons
blocks.text: Woh compounds jin ke molecules mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen hon, hydrocarbons kehlate hain.
Carbon ke skeleton (dhaanche) ki base par hydrocarbons do bari types (qismon) mein baante jate hain:

a) Jin hydrocarbons mein carbon atoms ki open chain (khuli zanjeer) ho, unhein open chain ya acyclic hydrocarbons kehte hain, aur zyada tar aliphatic hydrocarbons. (Greek lafz “aleiphatos” ka matlab fat (charbi) hai; fats ka structure open chain hota hai.) In ki aage do types hain: saturated hydrocarbons (alkanes) aur unsaturated hydrocarbons (alkenes aur alkynes).

blocks.alt: Chhota peela dabba: 'Aliphatic' likha oval, plus ka nishan aur 'Cyclic' likha oval, lakeeron se neeche 'Alicyclic' likhe rectangle se jure hue.
blocks.caption: Aliphatic + cyclic: alicyclic (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki yeh chhoti drawing kehti hai: jo hydrocarbon ring (cyclic) wala ho lekin behaviour (rawaiya) aliphatic jaisa ho, woh alicyclic hai. Poori classification yun samjhein: hydrocarbons ya to open chain hain (aliphatic: saturated alkanes, unsaturated alkenes aur alkynes) ya closed chain (cyclic). Cyclic ki do types hain: alicyclic (maslan cyclohexane) aur aromatic (benzene jaise rings).
b) Jin hydrocarbons mein carbon atoms ke rings (halqe) hon, unhein closed chain ya cyclic hydrocarbons kehte hain. In ki bhi do types hain:

items: Kuch cyclic hydrocarbons, saturated hon ya unsaturated, bilkul aliphatic hydrocarbons jaisa behaviour rakhte hain. Inhein alicyclic hydrocarbons kehte hain, maslan cycloalkanes aur cycloalkenes.
Kuch cyclic hydrocarbons mein benzene ring ya us jaisa structure hota hai. Inhein aromatic hydrocarbons kehte hain, maslan benzene, naphthalene aur diphenyl methane.

blocks.alt: Do groups saath saath, darmiyan khari moti lakeer. Baen, do qataron mein aliphatic hydrocarbons: CH3-CH3 (ethane), H2C=CH2 (ethene), HC teen-bond CH (ethyne) aur aik hexagon (cyclohexane). Daen, aik qatar mein aromatic hydrocarbons, har ring hexagon jis ke andar circle (daira): benzene, methyl benzene (ring par CH3), naphthalene (do jure rings) aur anthracene (teen jure rings aik line mein).
blocks.caption: Aliphatic aur aromatic hydrocarbons ki misalein (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab cyclohexane ko “Aliphatic hydrocarbons” wali taraf rakhti hai, kyun ke alicyclic compounds ka behaviour aliphatic jaisa hota hai. Aromatic taraf har ring ke andar ka circle benzene ke phaile hue (delocalised) π electrons dikhata hai. Naphthalene mein do aur anthracene mein teen benzene rings aapas mein jure (fused) hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Neeche kitab ke diye gaye compounds ko aliphatic, alicyclic ya aromatic mein rakhein (i se vii). (v) aur (vi) kitab mein structure ke baghair chhape hain.
blocks.explanation: (i) methylcyclohexane: alicyclic. (ii) 1-methylcyclohexa-1,4-diene (ring mein do alag double bonds hain, yeh benzene ring nahi): alicyclic. (iii) methylbenzene: aromatic. (iv) naphthalene: aromatic. (vii) cyclohexane: alicyclic.

blocks.alt: Do qataron mein saat items. Pehli qatar: i) single bonds wala hexagon (chhe kone ki shakal), upar daen carbon par CH3; ii) hexagon jis ke baen aur daen pehlu par double bond hain, upar daen carbon par CH3; iii) teen double bonds wala benzene ring, upar daen carbon par CH3; iv) do jure rings (naphthalene). Doosri qatar: v) aur vi) sirf label, koi structure nahi; vii) single bonds wala hexagon.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 19.2 (a): classify karne wale compounds, i) se vii) (kitab mein chhape structures ke mutabiq original drawing).

items: Cyclic: alicyclic (aliphatic jaisa behaviour, maslan cyclohexane) ya aromatic (benzene ring wale).
